offering_description.value: Develops and sells a targeted oral cancer drug for HER2-positive breast cancer patients. Sells it to oncology providers in the US and licenses rights to partners in other countries, which handle sales there.

primary_products.value: neratinib, an oral HER2-targeted breast cancer drug

customer_segment.value: B2B: oncology clinics, hospitals, specialty pharmacies, drug wholesalers

revenue_model.value: product sales: drug sold to specialty distributors and pharmacies; licensing or royalties: milestone and royalty payments from partners selling the drug abroad

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: outsources manufacturing and markets the drug to oncology providers and distributors

geography_served.value: global: US direct sales, licensed partners in Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: niche specialist: single cancer drug franchise built on neratinib

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: oncology sales force calling on cancer treatment centers; distributors / dealers: specialty pharmaceutical distributors; partners / resellers: licensed partners selling the drug in other countries
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drug approval needed to sell cancer medicine, regulated by FDA and foreign drug agencies
